facts.fact: The Minister of Communication, in charge of Posts and Telecommunications, drew on the Politique Nationale de Developpement des TIC at the WSIS Forum 2025 (Geneva, 7-11 July 2025) to report progress on the digital divide: broadband access infrastructure covering most of the territory, and two large sector projects (Djibouti Digital Foundations and the East Africa regional digital integration project) laying the base of a digital economy; the document is the ministry's own news item dated 2025-07-11 and gives no adoption date, period, costs or targets for the policy.
